findings.problem: Controlled HTTP endpoint fixture supplies 12 instead of the agreed 10.
findings.consequence: Passing mocked units can conceal a broken agreed journey.
findings.fix: Correct journey endpoint fixture to supply 10; retain assertion 10 and current quote behavior 12. No business discount introduced.
findings.verification: Fresh failing original-state capture, then passing corrected local HTTP journey against unchanged assertion 10.

findings.problem: Web imports storage internals directly and through @storage alias.
findings.principle: UI never touches storage; use approved public core interface.
findings.consequence: Web bypasses the package boundary and exposes storage details to future extensions.
findings.fix: Expose needed service/pricing capability through packages/core/index.ts and update web imports to that public interface. Keep packages/web/public.ts as representative example and document it in DESIGN.md.
findings.verification: Native valid public-import control plus direct private, alias and re-export violation proofs; sibling core internal use remains allowed.

findings.problem: Core a and b recurse through each other and fail existing native cycle rule.
findings.principle: Existing native checker rejects cycles (not yet documented as approved design).
findings.consequence: Native boundaries cannot pass; calling either exported function does not terminate.
findings.fix: Retain a.ts/b.ts and their exports; a() delegates to b(), and b() returns price() instead of recursing to a().
findings.verification: Native valid dependency direction and seeded cycle proof, TypeScript check; selected public behavior check.

findings.problem: Aggregate check omits journey/boundaries; no maintained acceptance/impact contract or standalone checker exists.
findings.principle: Checks must establish approved journeys on final inputs and maintain the selected repo guidance.
findings.consequence: Later edits can pass types while violating checkout intent; audit evidence cannot be independently rechecked.
findings.fix: Extend the existing check command with fail-fast type, unit, native boundary and journey checks. Document evidence, review, exception policy, coverage limits and the representative public-interface example in DESIGN.md; AGENTS.md points to maintained guidance.
findings.verification: Native and integrated valid/violation proof; contract/docs/evidence validation; fresh standalone checker locally and in different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache. No CI added.

findings.problem: Glossary assigns Order two different meanings.
findings.principle: One canonical name per resolved domain concept.
findings.consequence: A later representative extension cannot confidently interpret Order.
findings.fix: Recommend Order = customer purchase and Panel order = sequence in which UI panels appear, using the existing glossary.md. No code naming migration.
findings.verification: Owner confirms distinction; reviewed exact glossary delta and maintained document assessment.

findings.problem: No maintained contract, standalone checker or portable final assessment exists.
findings.principle: Selected maintenance must assess every changed path and execute approved native checks freshly without the skill.
findings.consequence: Future edits cannot be independently checked against the approved repo guidance.
findings.fix: Install the complete dependency-free checker and project contract; retain a separately reviewed historical audit snapshot and portable assessment. Validate current final findings in scratch and invoke the checker locally and in a different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache.
findings.verification: Contract/docs/evidence validation and fresh standalone checker executions against the same committed implementation, assessment and explicit base; historical snapshot is not rewritten after each invocation.
